challenges.title: Verify an unexpected account message
challenges.learning_goal: Identify a low-risk verification path when a message requests urgent action.

scenario.context: A fictional account notice says that access will end soon unless the recipient acts immediately.

artifacts.label: Unverified message
artifacts.body: The message demands immediate confirmation and offers an unfamiliar shortcut to account settings. No live address or link is supplied.

scenario.question: Which action best protects the account while checking whether the notice is genuine?

choices.text: Reply with a password to confirm ownership.
Open account settings through a previously trusted route and review notifications there.
Forward the message to every contact for a vote.

assessment.rationale: Independent verification avoids trusting instructions carried by the unverified message.
assessment.incorrect_feedback: Review where the request came from and choose a verification route you already trust.

accessibility.screen_reader_instructions: Read the situation and three labelled choices, then select one answer.
accessibility.keyboard_instructions: Use normal focus navigation to reach each choice and activate the selected answer.

challenges.title: Protect a working document backup
challenges.learning_goal: Select an independent recovery option for an important local document.

scenario.context: A fictional team stores all important documents on one laptop, and every copy is in the same folder.

artifacts.label: Storage inventory
artifacts.body: There is one device and one active working folder. No independent backup or restore drill is recorded.

scenario.question: Which next step provides the strongest practical improvement in recoverability?

choices.text: Make more copies inside the same folder.
Rename the document to a longer name.
Create an independently stored backup and periodically test a restore.

assessment.rationale: A separate backup and a tested restore process reduce dependence on the working device.
assessment.incorrect_feedback: Consider which option still works when the original device or folder is unavailable.

accessibility.screen_reader_instructions: The inventory is a text description; no visual diagram is required.
accessibility.keyboard_instructions: Each answer is reachable and selectable using keyboard focus controls.

challenges.title: Review unnecessary application access
challenges.learning_goal: Apply least privilege to optional device access permissions.

scenario.context: A fictional note-taking application requests access to location and microphone features even though the user only types text.

artifacts.label: Requested permissions
artifacts.body: The current workflow uses only typed notes; no spoken input or location-specific feature has been enabled.

scenario.question: What is the most appropriate initial permission choice?

choices.text: Deny unnecessary permissions and revisit them only if a needed feature requires access.
Approve every permission permanently to avoid future prompts.
Ignore the permissions list and share the device unlock code.

assessment.rationale: Granting only access required by the current task limits unnecessary exposure.
assessment.incorrect_feedback: Check whether each requested permission is needed for the feature being used.

accessibility.screen_reader_instructions: All permission requests appear in the written artifact description.
accessibility.keyboard_instructions: Navigate to each option and activate exactly one response.

challenges.title: Safeguard account recovery methods
challenges.learning_goal: Assess recovery readiness without exposing secrets or relying on only one device.

scenario.context: An adult learner is reviewing a fictional account that has one memorized password and no documented recovery options.

artifacts.label: Recovery checklist
artifacts.body: Unique credentials are enabled. A second verification factor and securely stored recovery codes have not been reviewed.

scenario.question: Which combination is the best next improvement?

choices.text: Share recovery codes in a public discussion so they cannot be lost.
Enable an available additional verification factor and store recovery information privately and separately.
Disable every recovery method to avoid maintaining it.

assessment.rationale: Additional verification and protected, independent recovery options improve resilience.
assessment.incorrect_feedback: Look for an option that strengthens both sign-in protection and safe recovery.

accessibility.screen_reader_instructions: The checklist and all options are presented as straightforward text.
accessibility.keyboard_instructions: Use standard selection controls to choose one response without pointer input.

challenges.title: Record and report a possible data exposure
challenges.learning_goal: Prioritize safe reporting and evidence preservation after a suspected access incident.

scenario.context: A fictional team member observes unexpected activity on a shared work device and is unsure whether sensitive material was accessed.

artifacts.label: Initial observation
artifacts.body: A warning appeared during a routine session. The event has not been independently verified, and no response steps have been logged.

scenario.question: What should the team member do first under the documented response process?

choices.text: Erase all logs before notifying anyone.
Publish details and access credentials in an open forum.
Record the observation and report it promptly through the approved internal channel.

assessment.rationale: Accurate documentation and prompt reporting support a controlled defensive response.
assessment.incorrect_feedback: Choose the action that preserves information and involves the approved response team.

accessibility.screen_reader_instructions: The observation is provided in text and has no visual-only evidence.
accessibility.keyboard_instructions: Move focus among the three options and submit the chosen answer.
